title: Syber Green PCR Prep with Cherrypicking
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare input CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file with the header line 'source well (A1-H12),mastermix tube (A1-D6),destination well (A1-H12)' and list each sample row (e.g., A1,A1,A1) for up to 96 samples.

steps.title: Load plates and tubes
steps.instruction: Place the 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes containing mastermix and the source strip tubes with DNA samples into the Opentrons 96‑well aluminum block; mount the MicroAmp PCR plate in the same block.

steps.title: Transfer mastermix to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons robot, transfer the user‑specified volume of mastermix from each indicated tube to the corresponding destination well in the PCR plate as defined in the CSV file.

steps.title: Transfer DNA samples to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons robot, transfer the user‑specified volume of each DNA sample from the source strip tube to the destination well that already contains the pre‑added mastermix, following the CSV mapping.
